input_roles.role: 本作字形气质、配色、材质参考
用户提供的上下紧凑嵌合结构参考，不沿用字形、冰蓝材质、V形边框

variants.name: 上下咬合
variants.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Design ONE original compact stacked Chinese title logo for the historical interactive film-game exactly "逆转五丈原".
INPUT ROLES: Image 1 is this game's OWN selected logo, the visual identity reference: use its matte carbon-black 逆转, antique gold 五丈原, restrained deep vermilion tips, elegant natural semi-running brush calligraphy and dry-ink/leaf grain. Image 2 is ONLY an abstract composition reference: study how two rows of lettering nest tightly and form one memorable compact silhouette. DO NOT copy Image 2's lettering, exact silhouette, central diamond, V separators, outlines, framing, ice colors, splash background or metallic bevels. No text from Image 2 may appear.
Exact title layout: upper row "逆转"; lower row "五丈原". Five correct simplified Chinese characters appear exactly once. Larger upper characters and three slightly smaller lower characters should be optically balanced and intentionally nested, not two unrelated lines with a wide straight gap. Design an original whole-lettering silhouette through stroke extension, scale, negative space and interlocking contours. Strokes may pass through empty spaces between characters but cannot cross and obscure any character. Do not lose critical strokes or merge character skeletons.
Typography: flowing but readable Chinese brush lettering, not Gothic, not Latin-inspired, not mechanically square cut. Natural soft/heavy brush starts, sharp light taper ends, dry bristle edges, varied stroke widths, a few long lyrical strokes. Main bodies mostly flat pigments with very shallow fine grain, no thick black border or sculpted metal sidewalls.
Palette: upper row mostly opaque black, sparse gold dry-brush highlights, lower row predominantly warm old gold with black brush breaks; vermilion confined to a few finishing strokes. Do not add white or ice blue.
Output: one standalone isolated logo, genuinely transparent background, compact roughly square-to-landscape canvas with 8% clear outer padding, all tips visible. No white rectangle, no black splash backdrop, no scene, no characters/people, no English, no tagline, no seals, no watermarks, no extras, no multiple designs. COMPOSITION 01: centered compact lettering mass, approximate overall aspect 1.25:1. Upper 逆转 spans 90% of lower 五丈原 width, with each upper glyph about 1.35 times a lower glyph's area. Let the lower sweeping stroke of 逆 gently arc into the open space above 五, while a fine descending end of 转 fits into the gap between 丈 and 原. Keep an irregular curving breathing gap between rows rather than a straight baseline divider. 五 and 原 subtly incline inward toward a stable 丈, making the mass feel cohesive but not rigidly symmetrical. Lower long fine tails remain modest and finish close to the main mass. The eye should see ONE original compact title silhouette. No enclosing border, no separate underlining flourish, no V shape.
